newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower on budget tax worries.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower on budget tax worries.

text.p: UK shares closed lower on Monday, as Wall Street's recent bull run ran out of steam while a press report sparked fears of an attack on tax breaks for pension funds in next month's UK budget.
Retreating from Friday's record, the FTSE 100 index ended 38.0 points lower to 4,745.1, with decliners in a near three-to-one majority.
NatWest led the decline, down five percent, after announcing the departure of its investment banking chief. Other bank and insurance stocks fell victim to profit-taking after recent gains.
